SIMULATOR_PID=$(pgrep -f "iPhone Simulator" | head -1)
if [ -z "$SIMULATOR_PID" ]; then
    SIMULATOR_PID=$(pgrep -f "Simulator" | head -1)
fi

echo "Simulator PID: $SIMULATOR_PID"

if [ ! -z "$SIMULATOR_PID" ]; then
    # Try to activate the Simulator window
    open -a Simulator
    sleep 0.5
    
    # Now try to send keyboard input using osascript
    # But first, let's check if osascript is available
    which osascript > /dev/null 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "osascript is available"
        # Try to send the Tab key
        osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 48' 2>&1
    else
        echo "osascript not available"
    fi
else
    echo "Simulator not found"
fi
EOF
